lmek001.name: Iron Striker
lmek001.description: A durable frontline skirmisher, designed to withstand heavy fire while delivering precise counterattacks.
lmek001.appearance: A four-legged brace frame with thick knee guards and a compact reactor torso. Flat gray plating is broken by red stencils, rivet seams, and exposed hydraulic lines.

lmek002.name: Shadow Phantom
lmek002.description: A nimble infiltrator, utilizing high mobility and evasive tactics to strike from the shadows and disappear.
lmek002.appearance: A two-legged infiltration rig with narrow shin assemblies and a tucked shoulder profile. Matte black armor is edged with dim blue trace lights and a retractable sensor spine.

lmek003.name: Specter Shadow
lmek003.description: A stealth-oriented combat unit with enhanced shielding, excelling in rapid ambushes and energy-based assaults.
lmek003.appearance: A low four-legged mech frame with beveled side armor and a wedge-shaped command hull. Its charcoal coating carries adaptive matte tiles and recessed optic slits.

lmek004.name: Storm Dancer
lmek004.description: A lightning-fast skirmisher designed for hit-and-run tactics.
lmek004.appearance: A two-legged sprint chassis with rear vector pods and slim hip actuators. Electric-blue bodywork uses white banding across the chest and thigh panels.

lmek005.name: Blitz Warden
lmek005.description: A rapid assault unit with reinforced kinetic shielding for fast engagements.
lmek005.appearance: A four-legged shield carrier with a broad belly frame and overbuilt shoulder blocks. Yellow hazard paint cuts across dark plates around a recessed torso projector.

lmek006.name: Striker Talon
lmek006.description: A high-mobility scout mech equipped with precision strike capabilities.
lmek006.appearance: A two-legged scout frame mounting three articulated arms around a narrow chest core. Dark graphite armor includes neon blue edge lighting and reinforced ankle gimbals.

lmek007.name: Falcon Edge
lmek007.description: A lightweight recon unit with superior speed and evasion capabilities.
lmek007.appearance: A four-legged recon lattice with telescoping stabilizers and a tall sensor mast. White ceramic armor with teal insets sits over clean panel lines and exposed antenna banks.

lmek008.name: Viper Stride
lmek008.description: An aggressive interceptor equipped with reactive plating and short-range weaponry.
lmek008.appearance: A four-legged interceptor frame with a segmented mid-body and offset shoulder vanes. Ribbed green plating is outlined in black around clustered intake vents.

lmek009.name: Ghost Mirage
lmek009.description: A stealthy hunter capable of slipping past enemy defenses unnoticed.
lmek009.appearance: A compact two-legged mech body with faceted armor cheeks and flush-mounted sensor channels. Adaptive camouflage film shifts between slate tones while narrow optical bars pulse softly.

lmek010.name: Raptor Fang
lmek010.description: A fast-moving combat unit specialized in precision flanking maneuvers.
lmek010.appearance: A two-legged skimmer frame with four torso-mounted arms and swept side stabilizers. Orange and black armor carries tactical numerals, vent grilles, and exposed coolant piping.
